long_biography.plain_text:
Viktor Rashnikov entered Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works as a mechanic in its equipment-repair shop. He studied metal-forming engineering while working, then moved through production, supply and technical posts. That shop-floor experience preceded appointments as chief engineer and general director, giving him operational command of the mill.

While running MMK, Rashnikov bought shares on the market until he secured control of the steelmaker. He later transferred day-to-day management to a successor but retained the board chairmanship. Control now sits through Altair, the holding company that directly controls MMK and identifies Rashnikov as its beneficiary.
